# typeassert: alwaysReturns with switch default (alwaysReturns coverage)
typeassert {
	var i I
	i.M() == 1 -> i.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type I interface { M() int }
type m1 int
func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func F(x I) int {
	if x.M() != 1 {
		switch x.M() {
		case 0:
			return 0
		default:
			return -1
		}
	}
	_ = x
	return 1
}
